anchor.quote: Notices that arrive wait until 9:00 and come in as one digest

messages.text: 9:00 is the work start in Settings. Quiet hours could end at your own work start instead, 8:00 for you.
Only a failed check on main should wake me.
A failed check on a branch stops nothing else, so it can wait for the digest.
The edit is in the page for you to accept.

suggestion.added: A failed check on main still interrupts; one on a branch waits for the digest.

anchor.quote: The sound stays off until the first notice after 9:00.

messages.text: Could the sound come back at my work start too?

anchor.quote: A Job asking a question waits until the next workday.

messages.text: Does a public holiday count as a workday?
Revision 2 dropped the workday rule: a question now waits an hour at most.
Yes: nothing that can wait interrupts on Saturday or Sunday.
